test_title: PYST 47: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the words in the brackets in the given sentence.

The bridge which (connecting) the two cities has been destroyed by the bomb.
solution:
The correct answer is: **connected**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Connected"** is the past participle form of the verb "connect," suitable for describing an action completed before the destruction.
 
• It implies that the bridge's function of connecting the two cities was true up until the destruction occurred.
 
• The usage of **"connected"** emphasizes the past state of connection that no longer exists due to the event (the bomb).
 
• This word choice reflects a change in the state caused by the destructive action, making it clear that the connection was in the past.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'**
